correctness.rationale: The proof gives a complete iff classification of forbidden connected triples; hence the Alexander dual is the 2,2;1 two-row chessboard complex plus exactly n matching edges. The published shellability theorem applies for all n>=5. Its integral wedge-of-3-spheres consequence, exact face-vector Euler count, interval-edge homotopy attachments, and integral combinatorial Alexander duality prove free homology of stated ranks in exactly the two degrees. Complete skeleton and pure facets prove non-shellability. The packaged independent definition-driven mod-two calculations agree for n=5,6,7 and direct original-complex homology agrees for n=5,6. No finite computation is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Perfect-matching deletion from a complete bipartite graph is a motivated and highly symmetric graph perturbation. Published complete-bipartite three-cuts have one reduced homology degree, whereas crown three-cuts have two separated integral degrees and new top-dimensional rank n, uniformly for an infinite natural family. This exact dual decomposition and nonshellability obstruction give substantive structural information beyond a polynomial face-count or routine finite verification.
